title: Life on the road with Armstrong
summary: Wilson describes the nightly gatherings in Armstrong's hotel room, his marijuana, and typing fan mail on the bus, and notes the wife Althea.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Yes, that man impressed me so much. And every night after the job, in the hotel room, the whole band would collect in Louis' room and have some coca colas,

or other soft drinks, and some whiskey -- he wasn't drinking himself, he'd just smoke his marijuana, and for a certain amount of time -- a half hour or so -- and then off to bed and into the bus the next day.
And then all day in the bus, traveling, he'd be typing, typing, typing -- answering his fan mail. He had a little portable typewriter he carried.

He was always friendly with the band, but not buddy buddy with anybody; and during that time, when This was about 1932. I was with him, his wife was a lady named Althea. That was after Lil, you never hear very much of her, but that was in the period in the early thirties.
